grna_name: # gRNA + iBAR Reference Lookup Table (generated by 00_format_reference.py)
# This file is the PRIMARY input for Steps 3–5 of the pipeline.
#   ibar_design_seq    - Original iBAR from the design file (oligo strand)
#   target_gene        - Target gene for this individual spacer
#   position           - Guide position within the dual-guide construct (1 or 2)
#   target_version     - Spacer version of the target combo
#   trna_version       - tRNA version used in construct (optional)
#   design_row_index   - Row index from the original design file
# The input design file must be in the format produced by the CROPseq-multi
# See the `design` section of config.yaml for details.
# IMPORTANT: Each design row produces TWO reference rows (pos1 + pos2).
#   - ibar_seq is reverse-complemented by default (rev_comp_ibar: true)
#     because the design file specifies iBARs on the oligo synthesis strand
#     while the pipeline reads them from the gRNA sequencing strand.
